purpose: Fresh near-matched native-CZ comparison of cached objective-guided and incumbent-informed pruning under saved IBM Fez calibrated noise.
matching: Compile both complete mask families at one fixed layout and routing seed with symbolic angles. For each cap choose the pair maximizing min(nativeCZ), with absolute nativeCZ gap<=2 and both<=cap. Ties: smaller gap, larger sumK, larger minK, lower summed duration, deterministic K/seed order. No padding. Retain exact-match intersections as diagnostics.
development_amendment: Single-seed and three-seed exact-match development profiles both severely underfilled budgets. Near-match tolerance2 chosen using only old public circuit resources; one seed retained because extra seeds did not improve matching. No fresh quality outcomes used.
training: Separate16 original training groups. For each matched-cap method fit one global angle pair against original full energy with identical768-call budget. Freeze fits before generating fresh data. Fixed24 controls reuse previously frozen EXP017/019 angles through EXP021.
noise: Native calibrated depolarization plus gate-time T1/T2, explicit T1/T2 relaxation during scheduled idle delays, and asymmetric readout. Zero-temperature, ideal initial reset. Same saved16-qubit Fez patch and calibration for all circuits. No crosstalk, leakage, drift or coherent calibration errors.
noise_cohort: Simulate all Babai-nonoptimal fresh cases plus4 outcome-independent sentinel cases. All128 cases enter hybrid statistics; optimal Babai incumbents make other hybrid outcomes deterministically optimal. This evaluation shortcut never supplies reference labels to selection or supports a runtime/standalone claim.
primary: At cap160, cached minus incumbent hybrid global-optimum success after1024 independent noisy samples; paired95% bootstrap combining group and independent trajectory resampling. Improvement only if lower bound>0. Report actual CZ counts and slack; pairing is within2 CZ, not exact equality.
secondary: Cap128 and fixed24 comparisons, ideal/readout-only/gate-idle controls, noise penalties, original expected distance, physical duration and full classical preprocessing/selection/compilation costs. Secondary intervals are descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims.
limitations: One small16-qubit toy Module-LWE family and one frozen calibration; no secure ML-KEM or scaling claim.
Near-matched within2 CZ under common caps; duration, gate placement and error exposure need not be equal.
All matching/compiler search cost is counted; this is a comparison protocol rather than a new standalone decoder.
Finite64-trajectory noisy probabilities imply Monte Carlo uncertainty and nonlinear plug-in bias; report separate MC and group intervals and jackknife sensitivity.
Caching changes CPU implementation cost only; any quantum/noise effect comes from the selected masks and circuits.
No quantum hardware, cloud jobs, purchases or repository publication.
